51:7.text: By the heaven full of paths,

51:8.text: (about Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân)

51:9.text: (i.e. from Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân)
is he who is turned aside
(by the Decree and Preordainment القضاء والقدر of Allâh)

51:11.text: Who are under a cover of heedlessness
(think not about the gravity of the Hereafter)

51:12.text: They ask: "When will be the Day of Recompense?"

51:13.text: a Day when they will be tried

51:14.text: ! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"

51:15.text: will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs

51:16.text: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinûn

51:17.text: They used to sleep but little by night
[invoking their Lord (Allâh) and praying, with fear and hope]

51:18.text: And in the hours before dawn, they were

51:19.text: And in their properties there was the right of the Sâ’il
(the poor who does not ask others)

51:20.text: And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty.

51:21.text: And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?

51:22.text: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.

51:23.text: Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth
(i.e. what has been promised to you)
, just as it is the truth that you can speak.

51:24.text: Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests
[three angels; Jibrîl (Gabriel) along with another two]

51:25.text: When they came in to him and said: "Salâm,
," and said: "You are a people unknown to me."

51:26.text: Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf
[as the property of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) was mainly cows]

51:28.text: Then he conceived fear of them
And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge
(about Allâh and His religion of True Monotheism)

51:29.text: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice: she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"

51:30.text: They said: "Even so says your Lord.
Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."
